description: This file contains test cases for functions related to formatting tool metadata, path shortening, and string manipulation used in a TypeScript project. It uses the Vitest testing framework to validate behavior of functions like shortenPath, shortenMeta, formatToolAggregate, and formatToolPrefix.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Shortens a file path by replacing the home directory with '~' if applicable.

methods.name: shortenMeta
methods.description: Shortens metadata strings by replacing the home directory with '~' and optionally retains colon suffix.

methods.name: formatToolAggregate
methods.description: Formats a collection of paths or notes into a grouped string with optional markdown and markdown-specific formatting.

methods.name: formatToolPrefix
methods.description: Formats a tool prefix string with optional label and filename, defaulting to 'Tool'.
